summary: Per-env mediator-share panel under CLAIM 17 scope (bounded-Q + mech-HELD), n=3919 cells / 11 envs. Each env's link operates through a different dominant mediator: eff_h (Acrobot), argmax_entropy (CartPole), q_divergence (DiscountingChain, SpaceInvaders, Freeway). FourRooms has no single dominant mediator. 4/11 envs (Asterix, MountainCar, Breakout, DeepSea) violate linear-mediation assumptions on most candidates - empirical lift gate for Pearl NDE/NIE counterfactual mediation.
scope: q_div<1 AND bf>0.5 AND jdg<0.05 AND n_step==1 AND no action_duplicate AND rs in {1.0, NaN} AND no polyak (CLAIM 17 chain_amplifier_link_active_in_bounded_q)
upstream_conditioning: jensen_gap delta < 0 (mech-HELD per CLAUDE.md conditioning rule)

FourRooms-misc.interpretation: distributed - no single mediator carries link

implications.claim_13_staleness_regime_specific: target_staleness_late HELD on FourRooms (capacity_sweep) and Breakout (sync=100) - but does NOT generalize to broader CLAIM 17 scope. Outside those specific corpora, staleness is MINOR / ASSUMP_FAIL across envs.
implications.claim_10_acrobot_mediator_resolved: Acrobot's link channel is effective_horizon (50%), not target_staleness_late. Consistent with GOAL polarity: DDQN reduces episode length, raising discounted return.
implications.fourroom_no_single_mediator: FourRooms with n=508 has no candidate dominating > 5%. Either irreducibly multi-channel or the actual mediator is unmeasured (gradient stability, exploration coverage, network curvature).
implications.counterfactual_mediation_lift_gate: 4/11 envs violate linear-mediation assumptions on most mediators - empirical FUTURE_WORKS.md sec 3a lift condition. mediation_counterfactual (Pearl NDE/NIE) primitive should be authored next.

next_bridges.acrobot_eff_h_mediates: TIER A2: effective_horizon mediates link on Acrobot at >= 50% under CLAIM 17 scope; DDQN's GOAL-polarity benefit flows through length-channel not staleness
next_bridges.cartpole_argmax_mediates: TIER A2: argmax_entropy_late mediates link on CartPole at >= 50%; action-selection channel even at standard rs (extends CLAIM 7e/f beyond rs=0.1)
next_bridges.q_divergence_mediates_within_bounded: TIER A1: q_divergence_score mediates link on Q-explosion-prone envs (DC, SI, Freeway) within bounded-Q scope - q_div is BOTH scope predicate AND mediator within scope
